Subject: RE: Pilot announcement / logo use question — proposed legal language

Team —

Thanks for the heads-up. We are generally comfortable with a narrow publicity carveout for the pilot provided the language limits disclosure to a "short announcement" and preserves our right to approve any customer quotes. Key points I recommend including in the MSA redline:

1) Publicity carveout (proposed snippet):
"Notwithstanding Section X (Confidentiality), Customer and Redwood may issue a brief public announcement limited to the existence of the pilot and the names of the parties; any additional materials that identify product details, performance metrics, or confidential implementation specifics require mutual written consent prior to publication."

2) Quote approval flow:
"Each party shall have 10 business days to review and approve any proposed public quote or case study content following submission; approval shall not be unreasonably withheld. No quote may be published without the other party's prior written consent."

3) Logo use and trademark attribution:
- Customer may display Redwood's logo in reasonable size and context on Customer marketing materials and on Customer's website.
- Use must comply with Redwood's trademark guidelines (attached as Exhibit A).
- Trademark legend: "Redwood InferenceTM" or as otherwise provided by Redwood.

4) Embargo/Timing: Recommend a 30-calendar-day mutual review/embargo after initial sign-off for any case study that contains product details. Short announcements limited to a one-paragraph blurb may be subject to a 14-calendar-day mutual sign-off window.

If sales prefers a shorter embargo for marketing reasons, we can accept 14 days for the simple announcement but reserve 30 days for any technical case study. I'll update the redline_msa_v3.pdf with these snippets and re-run the Order Form redline for signature fields.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_publicity_snippet.txt (inline below)

- Any case study or materials containing product performance or implementation details will require a 30-calendar-day review and explicit written approval.
- Logo use is permitted per our trademark guidelines (we've attached Exhibit A to the redline). Please don't alter the logo colors or remove the trademark legend.

Next steps:
1) Karthik will incorporate the publicity snippet into the MSA redline (redline_msa_v3.pdf).
2) Tom/Liz — please review the attached redlines and confirm if you have any mandatory provider language. If acceptable, can you sign the Order Form via DocuSign (link below) so we can kick off the pilot?
